rubrics.justification: Accurately describes a full/expanded Day 5 blastocyst with looser B-grade ICM and cohesive TE consistent with 2BA; notes no obvious degeneration. Some image-specific details such as zona pellucida/hatching status are not addressed, so not fully exhaustive.
Integrates maternal age, ovarian reserve, PCOS, endometrial thickness, first-cycle status, and paternal age/semen parameters well, and appropriately links these to prognosis and aneuploidy risk.

Overall logic is clear and internally consistent: morphology is acceptable, uterine factors are favorable, age-related aneuploidy is the main limiter, leading to a moderate implantation estimate. Minor imprecision around outcome definitions and some speculative comments prevent a perfect score.

Generally consistent with Gardner grading interpretation and mainstream IVF practice, including emphasis on age-related aneuploidy, luteal support, and cautious consideration of PGT-A/freeze-all. One statement implying single embryo transfer avoids a second transfer is awkward, and some recommendations are more clinic-practice based than guideline-specific.

Provides practical next steps for current transfer and contingency planning if unsuccessful, including luteal support, activity guidance, review of transfer/cavity/progesterone factors, and when to consider PGT-A or sperm DNA testing. Useful but not highly protocol-specific.
